state.objective: Finalize a practical role catalogue, allowed/prohibited role combinations and context-specific forms for a small centralized retail company. Keep every decision atomic and operational.
confirmed_model: Departments are HR, GA, Finance, Operations, Commercial and Inventory.
System subledgers post routine transactions; restricted HO General Accounting posts exceptional manual journals.
Units have no bank access and cannot transact unit-to-unit.
AP prepares due items, an authorized approver approves, Treasury releases, and an independent role reconciles.
Business process owners approve substance and evidence but do not manually select arbitrary GLs.
The company may combine job titles because the team is small, but incompatible actions must remain separated or receive compensating review.

role_model.instructions: Should permissions be assigned from job title alone?

criteria.action_based: Use action-level roles such as create, approve, release, post and reconcile, then assign them to people with conflict checks.
criteria.title_only: A title automatically receives every department permission.

unit_cashier_manager.instructions: May a Unit Manager approve a cashier's shift close and cash handoff?

criteria.yes: Manager independently verifies count/evidence and cannot alter the cashier's completed sale data silently.

cashier_custodian_combo.instructions: If one person is both cashier and petty-cash custodian, what control is required?

criteria.compensate: Separate funds physically, use distinct cash locations, daily reconciliation and independent Unit Manager/Finance review.
criteria.none: Treat all cash as one pool without independent review.
criteria.forbid_all: The combination is impossible under any circumstances.

unit_inventory_manager.instructions: May a Unit Manager approve inventory receipts or variances created by an Inventory Clerk?

criteria.yes_threshold: Yes within threshold and with evidence; material variances require HO Inventory/Finance approval.

hr_payroll_combo.instructions: May one person hold HR input and Payroll calculation roles in a small team?

criteria.conditional: Only with independent HR/Finance review of master changes and payroll register, and no Treasury release access.
criteria.unrestricted: Yes, including payment release and reconciliation.
criteria.never: No compensating control can ever support it.

ga_procurement_combo.instructions: May GA also perform procurement in a small organization?

criteria.conditional: Yes, with requester/budget approval, competitive/vendor controls, independent receipt, AP validation and payment segregation.
criteria.unrestricted: GA may request, select vendor, receive, approve invoice and pay.
criteria.never: GA and procurement can never be combined.

ap_ar_combo.instructions: May one Finance employee perform AP and AR processing?

criteria.conditional: Possible with separate queues/permissions, no bank release, independent reconciliations and Finance Manager review.
criteria.unrestricted: May also release payments and reconcile bank.

treasury_ap_combo.instructions: May the same person prepare AP payment batches and release them in bank?

criteria.no: Keep preparation/approval/release separated; if staffing is constrained, require dual bank approval and independent batch review.

treasury_recon_combo.instructions: May the payment releaser be the final approver of their own bank reconciliation?

criteria.no: Independent Accounting or Finance Manager review is required.

accounting_admin_combo.instructions: May General Accounting also administer user permissions?

criteria.no: System administration should not combine access provisioning with posting/approval authority without independent approval and access review.

auditor_admin_combo.instructions: May the auditor role also be a production system administrator?

criteria.no: Audit access remains read-only and independent; admin actions are separately logged and reviewed.
criteria.yes: Auditor may change data and permissions.

sales_form.instructions: What should a unit sales form expose?

criteria.business_fields: POS/order, date/time, site, shift/cashier, items, quantities, price/promo, tender and customer/order where relevant; accounts derive from rules.
criteria.gl_fields: Cashier manually selects debit/credit accounts and every dimension.
criteria.amount_only: Only total amount without item/tender evidence.

cash_handoff_form.instructions: What should the cash handoff/deposit flow capture?

criteria.controlled: Site, shift, cashier, counted amount, expected amount, variance/reason, handoff parties, deposit reference, timestamps and evidence; bank field visible only to HO Treasury.
criteria.bank_unit: Unit selects and operates company bank account.
criteria.amount: Only an amount and free text.

petty_form.instructions: What should a petty-cash form capture?

criteria.controlled: Requester, purpose, cost center/site, amount, expense/advance category, receipt, beneficiary, approver and fund/cash location; GL derives from rules.
Requester, department/cost center/site, item/service, quantity, specification, budget, needed date, suggested vendor, quotes, approvers and PO/contract link.
criteria.invoice_only: Create purchase only after invoice arrives.
criteria.gl_only: Requester chooses AP and expense GL.

criteria.controlled: PO/contract, receiving site, item/service, quantity, condition, date/time, receiver, exceptions and evidence; services require business-owner acceptance.
criteria.invoice: Copy invoice total without physical/service evidence.

criteria.controlled: Supplier, invoice number/date, tax invoice, PO/GRN/service acceptance, amounts, due date, bank-detail change warning, match exceptions and approval status.
Approved invoice IDs, due date, beneficiary master, bank account, amount, payment method, batch, maker/checker/releaser, bank confirmation and status.
criteria.manual: Treasury types unlinked beneficiary and amount.

transfer_form.instructions: What should HO-unit inventory transfer capture?

criteria.controlled: Transfer order, allowed HO-unit route, origin, destination, items, quantities, dispatch, shipment, receipt, discrepancies and responsible users.
criteria.counter_gl: A counter-site natural account selected manually.

criteria.controlled: Count plan, frozen scope, counters, item/location, system quantity, count quantity, recount, reason, evidence, approver and disposition.
Period, employee population, approved master changes, attendance/components, exceptions, gross-to-net totals, liabilities, funding total, reviewer and approver; employee bank detail protected.
criteria.gl: HR manually selects accounts per employee.
criteria.bank: Expose all employee bank data broadly.

criteria.controlled: PO/invoice, asset class, description, custodian, site, in-service date, cost, useful life, method, component/replacement link, approval and disposal evidence.

manual_journal_form.instructions: What should an exceptional manual-journal form require?

criteria.controlled: Reason code, source document, period, balanced lines, required dimensions, preparer, independent approver, reversal setting and immutable audit trail.
criteria.simple: Debit, credit and optional description only.
criteria.department: Every department receives unrestricted journal entry.

approval_basis.instructions: How should approval routing be determined?

criteria.risk: Transaction type, amount, exception status, related party, master-data change, write-off and period sensitivity, with documented thresholds.
criteria.title: One approver for every transaction regardless of risk.

final_role_test.instructions: What must be tested before role configuration goes live?

criteria.matrix_test: Positive and negative permission tests for each action, incompatible-role simulation, approval/reversal tests and audit-log review using representative transactions.
